label: Modular pipeline
description: Run a custom pipeline of connected tool modules (fastp, SPAdes, QUAST, MAFFT, FastTree, ...). Provide either a full pipeline definition or a curated template plus its exposed parameters.

parameters.label: Pipeline definition
parameters.desc: A modpipe/pipeline/v1 JSON object (see docs/MODULE_SCHEMA.md). Mutually exclusive with pipeline_template.

parameters.label: Curated pipeline template
parameters.desc: Name of a curated pipeline (pipelines/<name>.json in the service). Its inputs are replaced by `inputs`, and its exposed parameters can be set with `template_params`.

parameters.label: Template inputs
parameters.desc: For pipeline_template: map of template input name -> source object (e.g. {"reads": {"paired_end_libs": [...]}}).

parameters.label: Template parameters
parameters.desc: For pipeline_template: map of "<step>.params.<id>" -> value; only parameters listed in the template's expose list are accepted.

parameters.label: Keep intermediate outputs
parameters.desc: Also save every step's outputs, not only the pipeline's declared outputs.

parameters.label: File Basename
parameters.desc: Name of the job result; outputs go to <output_path>/.<output_file>/
